requirement: ROS2 package skeleton has package metadata, resource marker, launch/config files, README, and Python package.
boundary: File presence does not prove colcon build or runtime node execution.

requirement: All ROS2 preflight Python sources and reusable real-robot helpers compile with desktop Python.
boundary: Syntax compilation does not import ROS2 modules or execute nodes.

requirement: package.xml declares the expected package name, version, and ament_python build type.
boundary: Metadata identity does not prove installability in a ROS2 workspace.

requirement: Runtime dependencies cover geometry, odometry, std_msgs JSON payloads, rclpy, and TF lookup.
boundary: The current desktop environment is not proof that those ROS2 packages are installed.

requirement: package.xml declares basic lint/test dependencies for future ROS2 workspace CI.
boundary: Lint/test declarations are not equivalent to having run colcon test.

requirement: setup.py exposes the five preflight nodes and every node source defines main().
boundary: Entry-point presence does not prove colcon build or runtime launch.

requirement: setup.py installs package.xml, launch files, config files, and the resource marker.
boundary: Static setup inspection does not install the package.

requirement: Launch file defines generate_launch_description(), uses OpaqueFunction, and constructs Node actions.
boundary: Static launch structure does not execute ros2 launch.

requirement: Launch file exposes namespace, frame, leader-list, and leader-filter arguments.
boundary: Argument declaration does not prove operator-selected frame calibration.

requirement: Launch file exposes the software fault-injection arguments needed for preflight sweeps.
boundary: Software fault knobs do not replace physical occlusion or real sensor tests.

requirement: Launch file exposes POP/NIS confidence, gate, inflation, ghost-horizon, and lost-timeout parameters.
boundary: Parameter exposure does not prove runtime calibration.

requirement: Launch file can pass a results CSV path to the trial supervisor.

requirement: Launch file instantiates exactly the five preflight nodes.
boundary: Static Node action count does not prove nodes start successfully.

requirement: multi_robot_profile.yaml lists all local detection, POP, debug, trial, command, and safety topics.

requirement: Profile POP/NIS gates match the manuscript thresholds tau_soft=12, tau_hard=20, gamma=10.

requirement: Profile keeps low-speed controller limits suitable for supervised scaled-robot preflight.

requirement: experiment_parameters.yaml includes control frequency, horizon, timeout, headway, near-miss, and TTC abort rules.

requirement: experiment_parameters.yaml requests logging of selected leader, POP state, MPC debug, safe command, and TF.

requirement: ros2_topic_contract.csv has the expected schema and 13 interface topics.

requirement: Every topic in the contract is marked for bag logging.
boundary: A logging requirement is not proof of an actual rosbag.

requirement: Selected-leader contract includes leader_id, confidence, rank, and candidate_count fields.
boundary: Contract fields still require runtime message inspection.

requirement: Metric schema has 29 rows and 28 required fields, including latency p95/p99, watchdog triggers, frame drops, clock drift, command age, and CPU/GPU telemetry.
boundary: Schema completeness does not create measured metrics.

requirement: real_robot_results_template.csv includes every required metric-schema field.
boundary: The template contains an example row only; it is not physical trial evidence.
